name: market-sentinel
description: Cursor host for Market Sentinel (v0.6.5 local VSIX)

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Market Sentinel starts a local Python Core via uv in the workspace, so it requires a trusted workspace.

marketSentinel.coreRoot.description: Path to the Market Sentinel Core checkout (directory containing pyproject.toml). Required when no single workspace folder is open.

marketSentinel.uvPath.description: uv executable used to spawn the Python Core. Spawned with shell:false; no python/conda fallback.

marketSentinel.watchlist.description: Host watchlist intent. Core enforces the 10-symbol limit and symbol validation.

marketSentinel.provider.description: Core market data provider. longbridge uses process environment credentials (LONGBRIDGE_APP_KEY / SECRET / ACCESS_TOKEN). Do not put secrets in settings. http is a deprecated Core stub.

marketSentinel.replayPath.description: Replay fixture path. Required when provider is replay.

marketSentinel.enableHoverDetails.description: Show a compact market snapshot in the StatusBar hover. Full scrollable details are available from Market Sentinel: Show Details. Host-only; changing it does not restart the Python Core.

marketSentinel.alertToast.description: Optional notification for unsolicited critical alert edges. Host-only; changing it does not restart the Python Core. Default off.

marketSentinel.intelligence.description: Optional Intelligence sidecar. on → --intelligence, off → --no-intelligence, inherit omits the CLI flag so MARKET_SENTINEL_INTEL_ENABLED / Core default apply. Restart Core after changing. API keys stay in the process environment, not in settings.

marketSentinel.symbolNames.description: Display aliases for watchlist symbols. UI only; canonical IDs such as 600519.SH are unchanged.

marketSentinel.symbolDisplay.description: How to show symbol aliases. StatusBar prefers the short name when an alias exists.

marketSentinel.statusBarMaxSymbols.description: Maximum quotes shown in the StatusBar before +N overflow.
